name: gutt-agent-intelligence-plugin
description: Agent experience distillation for gutt. Binds captured lessons to agent identities and grounds each session with the agent's accumulated wisdom.

agent_id.title: Agent ID override
agent_id.description: Override the auto-resolved project agent_id. Leave empty to use git-remote slug → git-root basename → cwd basename fallback.

lesson_max_results.title: Lesson max results
lesson_max_results.description: Maximum number of lessons to retrieve for session grounding.

lesson_time_range.title: Lesson time range
lesson_time_range.description: Time range passed to fetch_lessons_learned for session grounding (e.g. 30d, 7d, all).
